workflow: An operation constructs a temporary owned object while converting an argument.
Validation determines that the constructed object has an invalid type and raises a recoverable error.
The error path exits without releasing the temporary object’s ownership reference.
Repeated invalid operations retain each temporary object, causing memory growth and leak reports instead of clean failure handling.
summary: Exceptional validation failure omits temporary-object cleanup
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches an exceptional validation path that leaves an intermediate owned allocation unreleased, causing leaks across repeated failures.
